evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 121 and no payload.
Exact client region-loader analysis shows rs.Client.bw() emits opcode 121 only after required terrain/object resources are present and Client.l() completes the synchronous scene rebuild.
Six captured normal-region transitions produced six packet-73 region changes followed by six opcode-121 completions, consistently ordered SCENE_REBUILD_EXIT -> opcode 121 -> bw() status 0.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 normal-region/scene loading completion acknowledgement. Constructed-region behavior remains a separate evidence boundary.
